prompt:
Bagseed approved-style character REDRAW. Kenji Mori: East Asian man, black side-parted hair, rectangular dark glasses, warm light skin, plain gray crew-neck sweatshirt, navy jeans, dark sneakers. Tall but still short soft limbs and large round head. Reference1 is identity ONLY, NOT proportions or drawing style. Reference2 defines the required style: a BIG ROUND head about ONE THIRD of full figure height, head nearly shoulder-width, LARGE dark eyes EACH with clear WHITE highlight dot, friendly soft cheeks, small mouth, short soft limbs and mitten hands. Warm dark-BROWN outlines, 2-3 tone CEL shading, solid hair/beard shapes, no texture grain or stubble. No broad square shoulders, muscles, lanky adult proportions or dot eyes. Match Remy/Priya for average builds and Doug's soft belly for heavy builds.
Produce ONE SQUARE transparent 3-column x 3-row atlas, nine NONOVERLAPPING evenly sized cells, generous empty transparent gutters. Row1: full-body IDLE FRONT, full-body RIGHT PROFILE, full-body BACK. Row2: shoulder-up PORTRAIT NEUTRAL, PORTRAIT FRIENDLY smiling, PORTRAIT CONCERNED; heads fill about 60% of portrait height. Row3: full-body HOLDING NOSE FRONT, HOLDING NOSE RIGHT PROFILE, HOLDING NOSE BACK, pinching nose with one hand, other arm lowered, exact same standing body size as Row1. All full-body drawings show complete shoes, consistent ground line within each cell, no walking stride. No text, labels, borders, ground shadows, glow or background. Clear readable game sprite illustrations, head/body ratio is the priority.
